title: The Genomic Research in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Sarcoidosis Study (GRADS) Sarcoidosis study [Sarc]
description: Whole genome mRNA and microRNA profiling of bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) and peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) in Sarcoidosis patients Overall design: 199 Sarcoidosis patients were enrolled in the Genomic Research in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Sarcoidosis study (GRADS) following the GRADS study protocol (Moller et al., Ann Am Thorac Soc, 2015 PMID: 26193069), including 24 stage I, 33 stage II-III treated, 40 stage II-III untreated, 17 stage IV treated, and 12 stage IV untreated.
